subject: general
question: Which of the following diseases is caused by the prolonged deficiency of vitamin D?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Rickets**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Vitamin D deficiency causes rickets.
 
• The chemical name of Vitamin D is Cholecalciferol.
 
• It was discovered by Edward Mellanby.
 
• It is fat-soluble.
 
• It is found in Fish, eggs, liver, mushrooms.​
